Apply Module.Basis.sum_repr with ι=I, R=K, M=V(K), b=β. K is a field and V(K) is its vector space, so the semiring, additive commutative monoid and module premises hold. Given the nonzero vector already obtained from W≠{0}, all-zero coordinates would make the displayed finite sum zero, as the prose explains.
